Definition: Shammua, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shammua = "renowned"; 1) son of Zaccur and the spy from the tribe of Reuben; 2) son of David by his wife Bathsheba; 2a) also 'Shammuah' and 'Shimea'; 3) aLevite, son of Galal and father of Abda who lived in Jerusalem after the return from exile in the time of Nehemiah; 3a) also 'Shemaiah'; 4) a priest, head of the family of Bilgah in the time of Joiakim after the return from exile
